title: Salmon & Green Beans with Dill Yogurt
description: Roasted salmon and green beans with a tangy lemon-dill yogurt sauce.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss green beans with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt; roast on a sheet pan for 8 minutes.
Brush salmon with remaining oil, season, and add it to the pan. Roast about 10–12 minutes, until the salmon reaches 145°F (63°C) internally.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon juice and garlic.
Serve salmon and green beans with the sauce on the side.
